newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec industrial output up revised 0.1% m/m.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec industrial output up revised 0.1% m/m.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in December increased a revised 0.1 percent from the previous month, compared with a preliminary estimate of a 0.3 percent rise, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.
December industrial production increased a revised 3.7 percent from a year earlier, against a preliminary estimate of a 3.9 percent increase.
For calendar 1996, industrial output rose a revised 2.6 percent from 1995, the same as the preliminary estimate.
Industrial output rose a revised 3.2 percent in the October-December period from the previous quarter and rose a revised 4.9 percent from the same period a year earlier.
